mi-hb-5595-2026.sponsors: Rep. Dylan Wegela; cosponsors include Reps. Wortz, Paquette, Fox, Foreman, Miller, DeSana, Smit, Byrnes, and Schriver
mi-hb-5595-2026.status: Introduced 2026-02-26; referred to House Committee on Government Operations; no further action as of 2026-07-31
mi-hb-5595-2026.key_provisions: Bars MPSC approval of any electric-utility contract, tariff, discount, or rate with a qualified data center until 2027-04-01.

mi-hb-5596-2026.sponsors: Rep. Joseph Fox; cosponsors include Reps. Wortz, Wegela, Byrnes, Paquette, Foreman, DeSana, Smit, and Schriver
mi-hb-5596-2026.status: Introduced 2026-02-26; referred to House Committee on Government Operations; no further action as of 2026-07-31
mi-hb-5596-2026.key_provisions: Tie-bar amendment to the Michigan Zoning Enabling Act referencing the Data Center Regulation Act.

mi-hb-5881-2026.sponsors: Reps. Reggie Miller, Dievendorf, and Paiz
mi-hb-5881-2026.party: D (all three; Reggie Miller and Emily Dievendorf both list profiles on housedems.com; Paiz does not appear on the Michigan House Republican caucus roster at gophouse.org/members)
mi-hb-5881-2026.status: Introduced 2026-04-23; referred to House Committee on Government Operations; no further action as of 2026-07-31
mi-hb-5881-2026.key_provisions: Tie-bar amendment to the Michigan Zoning Enabling Act adding reference to the Data Center Planning and Responsibility Act.

mi-hb-5882-2026.sponsors: Reps. Reggie Miller, Dievendorf, and Paiz
mi-hb-5882-2026.status: Introduced 2026-04-23; referred to House Committee on Government Operations; no further action as of 2026-07-31
mi-hb-5882-2026.key_provisions: Regulates local moratoria on large-scale data centers and cryptocurrency mining facilities; requires ordinance or resolution at a public meeting, public-interest findings, hardship appeal, NDA prohibition, 6-month initial cap, one 90-day extension cap, final hearing, and MPSC thresholds for large-scale classification.

mi-sb-761-2025.status: Introduced 2025-12-18; referred to Senate Committee on Energy and Environment; no further action as of 2026-07-31
mi-sb-761-2025.key_provisions: Prohibits water withdrawal permits for users averaging over 2,000,000 gallons/day for consumptive use.

mi-sb-762-2025.status: Introduced 2025-12-18; referred to Senate Committee on Energy and Environment; co-sponsors added 2026-06-24 and 2026-07-01; still pending, no committee vote as of 2026-07-31
mi-sb-762-2025.key_provisions: Requires data-center energy and water usage reporting through amendment to MCL 460.5a.

mi-sb-763-2025.status: Introduced 2025-12-18; referred to Senate Committee on Energy and Environment; co-sponsors added 2026-06-24 and 2026-07-01; still pending, no committee vote as of 2026-07-31
mi-sb-763-2025.key_provisions: Bars water utilities from passing data center infrastructure costs onto residential customers.
